toasts.contactIncomplete: Please fill in all your contact details.
toasts.serverFailed: The server could not save the calculation – we are showing you the local assessment. We have not received your request — please contact us directly.
toasts.success: Request sent — we will get back to you within one working day.
toasts.connectionFailed: Connection problem – we are showing you the local assessment.

oversize.title: Very large selection for a single-family home
oversize.text: The selected roof areas add up to more than 25 kWp – that is more than typical for a single-family home. Please check whether all selected segments really belong to your property (Sonnendach sometimes groups neighbouring buildings or garages together).

manual.title: Enter roof data yourself
manual.text: If the address is not registered in Sonnendach.ch or you already know the values, enter them here.
manual.note: Note: while federal data is active, orientation, tilt and shading are not used for the calculation — the Sonnendach values are more accurate. These fields are for your overview only.

federal.usable: We calculate with {area} m² of usable module area from Sonnendach.ch.

buildingType.description: Choose the category that best fits your property.

consumption.label: Annual electricity consumption (kWh)
consumption.description: You will find this figure on your latest electricity bill. Typical: single-family home approx. 4’500 kWh, with electric boiler approx. 7’500 kWh; with heat pump and electric car 8’000–16’000 kWh (ElCom profiles).

loads.heatPumpDescription: Increases the possible self-consumption and influences the system sizing.
loads.evDescription: With an EV charger and PV surplus, self-consumption rises significantly.

advanced.priceDescription: Basic and metering fees of your grid operator remain fixed and cannot be avoided with PV.
advanced.feedInDescription: Excluding guarantee-of-origin payments; many grid operators pay extra for GoO (approx. 1–2.5 Rp./kWh).

contact.title: Your contact details for the personal assessment
contact.text: We will e-mail you the personal assessment and get in touch within one working day to discuss the next steps. Your request is recorded in our system at the same time.
contact.name: Name *
contact.consentDescription: We use your data solely to process your request.

roof.areaDescription: Estimate the total roof area – we account for the usable share separately.
roof.usableDescription: Share excluding skylights, chimneys, dormers and clearance areas.

address.label: Address of your house (for precise federal data)
address.description: With your address we retrieve the official Sonnendach.ch values from the Swiss Federal Office of Energy – roof area, orientation and irradiation per segment. You can skip this step at any time.
address.clickHint: Click the map if a different building is meant
address.noData: No Sonnendach data is available for this address.
address.noDataText: The SFOE Sonnendach.ch register does not cover every building (e.g. new builds or protected locations). Enter the values manually below.
address.modelYield: model yield per year · data source: SFOE Sonnendach.ch

result.sizing: {kwp} kWp on approx. {area} m² of usable roof area

stats.systemHint: on approx. {area} m² of roof area
stats.selfConsumptionHint: Share of solar production you use yourself — {kwh}
stats.co2Hint: * See footnote in the notes below

result.cumulativeText: Linear projection based on the realistic annual savings. Without electricity price increases.
result.batteryNotPriority: Battery storage not a priority right now
result.batteryCheck: We will assess the added value in the personal analysis.
result.receivedText: This assessment has just been sent to our team as well. We will review your details, clarify subsidy options and get in touch personally about the next steps.
